articles.summary: RB Global, Inc. (NYSE TSX: RBA, the “Company”, “RB Global”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) reported the following results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. "Our third-quarter results demonstrate the strength of RB Global's marketplace and the consistent execution of our teams to deliver solid topline and bottom-line growth," said Jim Kessler, CEO of RB Global. “We remain committed to gaining market share, delivering strong growth across all our businesses, and generating improved operating leverage. By increasing our clarity and focus across the organization, we remain confident in our ability to continue creating meaningful value for our customers, partners, and shareholders, while advancing our strategic initiatives that will position us for durable long-term growth." Third Quarter Financial Highlights123: Gross transaction value ("GTV") increased 20% year over year to $4.7 billion. Revenue increased 17% year over year to $1.3 billion.
